lines.text: Neon lies atop a mechanical platform with her eyes open, staring at the ceiling.
Tears are running down her cheeks.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Is Princess alive?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: No. There's no chance of that.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Jien.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Did you find the password?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: I've tried everything I can think of, but nothing happens.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: For someone who accessed my brain without permission, you really didn't get much out of it.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Hey, at least you remember your past now.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Yeah, I do thank you for that, even if it was a bit painful.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Shall we start by talking about D.E.E.P.?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Just like that?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: It's something that concerns Princess as well, though I'm sure you've already guessed as much.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I'm listening.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Would you like me to get you some tea?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I'll pass.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Okay, well if we're going to discuss D.E.E.P.,

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: we'll have to go all the way back to the distant past.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Long, long ago, before even the Raptures appeared,

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: there used to be a religion called V.T.C.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: I say "religion," but in reality they were more like a biotechnology research institute.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: No one knows how they managed it, but the level of technology they possessed was extraordinary.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Their work in the medical field, in particular, defied belief.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: They branded what they did as "miracles" and gained devotees by the thousands.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Hm, perhaps "brand" might not be the right word for it. Their work was miraculous, after all.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: They were able to fix or cure just about anyone, so long as the person wasn't already dead. They could regrow severed limbs, restore necrotized nerves...

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: They could even transfer a person's brain to an entirely new body. They did all sorts of things.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Anyway, as they did all that, they gained a massive number of followers.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: And naturally, they started to get arrogant.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: They pursued projects like the Mechanical Messiah and the Ark—projects that could change the entire fate of humanity—as if they were little pet projects.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: But then the Raptures invaded, and humanity was given a new technology: the Nikkes.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Since Nikkes are similar to humans, combining them with V.T.C.'s technology made them all the more formidable.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: From that moment on, V.T.C. rose to absolute power.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: And what do you think happened as a result?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: That kind of arrogance usually ends in ruin.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Exactly. In their arrogance, they conducted every experiment imaginable, causing one disaster after another.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: That was something the United Forces of Humanity absolutely couldn't tolerate.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: But what could they do? The answer is nothing, because at the time, the world revolved around V.T.C.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Then came the decision to move humanity to the Ark, and V.T.C. and the United Forces of Humanity merged into a single entity: the Central Government.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: They dressed it up as "uniting for the sake of humanity," but in reality it was just a power struggle.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: They eventually agreed to split the benefits evenly,

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: but the real power within the Central Government rested entirely with V.T.C.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Those from the United Forces of Humanity simply couldn't stomach it.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: In the midst of all that,

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: V.T.C. suffered near-annihilation at the hands of Andersen, one of the current deputy chiefs.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: They were completely wiped out by a single person.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Why did he do it?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: But they took that opportunity to purge V.T.C. from within the Central Government.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: The purge went very smoothly, not in part because their leader, Her Holiness, was gone after... well, you know what happened to her.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: These days, there's barely any trace of them left.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Were those people I saw at the entrance V.T.C. survivors?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: They're a bit different. They're called D.E.E.P.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: They're Nikkes created by V.T.C. to be technology specialists.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: As Nikkes, their minds operate at full capacity 24/7, and their bodies were implanted with brilliant, cutting-edge technology.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: They were essentially the driving force behind the explosive advancement of V.T.C.'s technology.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: They even gave themselves embarrassing nicknames like "Guardians of the Ark."

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Oh, it's worth mentioning that M.M.R. was originally a joint project between them and Missilis.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: It's no coincidence that M.M.R. has all sorts of dubious tech.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: But how did people that important end up like those people I saw...?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Even though V.T.C. was purged, they couldn't do the same with D.E.E.P. because they relied too heavily on them.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: D.E.E.P held the keys to the core operational technologies of the Ark.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: But when D.E.E.P. saw V.T.C., the place they called home, being purged, they snapped.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: So they took the Ark as hostage and tried to blackmail the Central Government.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: I can't quite remember what they said they'd do, but it had something to do with power sources.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Unfortunately for them, they made one catastrophic mistake:

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: They chose the Ark as their hostage.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Enikk completely obliterated D.E.E.P.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Heh, it's funny, isn't it? Enikk stayed quiet throughout all the internal strife and chaos that had happened up to that point,

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: yet the moment the Ark was threatened, she tore D.E.E.P. apart.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: That doesn't sound very funny to me.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: All authority previously held by D.E.E.P. became Enikk's, and D.E.E.P. was left with nothing.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Afterward, in an attempt to reclaim their previous glory,

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: they killed the symbol of the Ark, tearing it apart, and turned it into an expansive armament.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: What you saw back there was the punishment for their actions.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: How exactly were they punished?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Pseudo-cores were used to replace their power supplies, and everything below their spines was destroyed,

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: rendering them unable to do anything.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: ... That seems way too inhumane.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Neon...

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: If you knew more about what they did,

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: you'd be asking why they weren't killed on the spot. I can guarantee that much.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: They seemed to be looking for a key.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Ah, yes. The key. Your glasses.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Based on everything we've learned so far, there are three keys in total.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Each one contains the distilled essence of all the technology developed by V.T.C. and D.E.E.P.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: They say the high-ranking officials each possess a key.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: The one you have now was probably held by the leader of V.T.C.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Anyway, the reason those things at the entrance reacted to that key is simple.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: They believe the technology within it will help restore them to their former glory.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Even though that would never happen, of course.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: ... Hmm. Let's see. I think that's about everything I wanted to cover. Right?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Yes. You told her everything.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Now then, Neon.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Do you know why I'm sharing with you so many highly confidential secrets?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Are you trying to recruit me?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: As tempting as that sounds, no.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: The password... Do you not know what it is?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: We have no clue, since we're outsiders,

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: but since you lived with V.T.C.'s leader, you might know something without even realizing it.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: We don't know what hidden technology might be inside those glasses,

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: but if it exists, its value would make all these secrets pale in comparison.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: See, when V.T.C. was being purged, they destroyed all of their technology themselves.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: I've been telling you all this as a gesture of goodwill.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: That's rich, coming from the one who rummaged around my brain.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Come now, let's forget about the past.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: ... I have a few guesses.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Oh? And they are?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: How do I open the password screen?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Press both sides of the frame for five seconds. A password input screen should appear.
Neon presses the sides of her glasses.
A brief moment later, a screen appears displaying only the word "Password."
She stares at it.
For a second, the display flickers,
and the words "Hated sound" flash past.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: *Cough, cough*
*Beep*

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Voice tone and pattern verified.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Brainwave match confirmed.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Commencing scan.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: H-huh?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: What is this...?
Blue light streams out from Neon's glasses like a glowing path and wraps around her body.
Symbols and shapes flood across the lenses.
Moments later,
the light fades and the text disappears.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Scan complete.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Get healthy, Third.
*Beep*
Neon taps the side of her glasses without saying a word.
An image projects from the glasses and spreads across the wall.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: A blueprint...?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: It looks like... a Nikke's blueprint...

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Oh, it's the pretty lady who showed up on that screen every night...

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: So that's what that was.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Wait... That means this body utilizes both V.T.C.'s and D.E.E.P.'s technology.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Get a copy of it.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: That's not a problem, but I doubt we'll be able to put it to use.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I bet this body is designed specifically for me.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: She's right. During the scanning process, the body was made exclusive to Neon.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: It was able to scan and finalize its subject that quickly?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: I mean... it is ancient technology.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Are there components in the blueprint we can use?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Quite a few.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: There are also a lot of parts that I don't understand.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: We can't build this, not with our current technology.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: What do you mean we can't build it? We have the blueprint.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: A blueprint does us no good if we can't decipher it.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Unbelievable.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: You know how I got here by following the path reflected in my glasses?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: And?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I'm guessing my glasses led me here because Princess trusted M.M.R.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: But I don't think that trust extends to the M.M.R. of today.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: What are you getting at?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I think she brought me here because she trusted those people at the entrance.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Those technology-specialist Nikkes.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: What, you want us to repair and use those things?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: If you don't want to, you don't have to.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: But I'm willing to bet...

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: the reason they were left alive instead of being killed...

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: is because eventually, if you ever managed to get your hands on a key, you were gonna need them to decipher it, right?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Well, if you ask me, that time is now.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Ether?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Needless to say, it's incredibly risky.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: High risk, high return. Isn't that great?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Well, I do enjoy high-risk, high-return ventures.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: But I don't know if you quite get it.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: The risk is far higher for you. You could die, Neon.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Well, you better keep me alive.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Because if I die, a lot of people are gonna be awfully sad and come looking for me.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: All right. Let's do it.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Okay then.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Time to get healthy.
